ideas.text: An AI that generates talking points for the 1:1 you have in 8 minutes and have not prepared for.
A bot that detects when your manager cancels your 1:1 for the 4th time and asks if you still report to them.
An app that tracks what topics come up in every 1:1 and identifies the one thing never actually resolved.
A tool that detects when a 1:1 has become a status update and converts it into a Slack thread.
An AI that translates 'how are you doing?' from a manager into whether they mean the work or the person.
A bot that detects when you've been saying 'things are good' in 1:1s for 3 months while clearly not feeling good.
An app that counts how many times you said you'd follow up on something from a 1:1 and then didn't.
A tool that generates the question you've been too nervous to ask your manager and frames it professionally.
An AI that detects when your manager is distracted during a 1:1 and sends them a 'you might want to focus' ping.
A bot that fills your 1:1 agenda with relevant topics when the shared doc has been blank since February.
An app that tracks the ratio of manager talking time to employee talking time across 1:1s over the quarter.
A tool that detects when your 1:1 is being used to download stress onto you rather than support you.
An AI that identifies when a 1:1 topic would be better addressed in writing and drafts the document instead.
A bot that detects when a 1:1 is happening 10 minutes before a company-wide deadline and suggests rescheduling.
An app that generates a polite way to tell your manager you need more feedback, not less meeting time.
A tool that monitors whether your 1:1 has become the only time your manager actually processes your work.
An AI that detects when 'great job' in a 1:1 is immediately followed by 'but here's the thing' and prepares you.
A bot that identifies which of your 1:1 action items your manager has never followed up on.
An app that detects when you're leaving a 1:1 more confused than when you arrived and files a clarity request.
A tool that tracks how long it's been since your manager proactively raised a topic versus waited for you to.
An AI that detects when a 1:1 has slid from 30 minutes weekly to 15 minutes biweekly to nothing and flags the trend.
A bot that detects when a difficult performance conversation is being avoided through increasingly pleasant 1:1s.
An app that identifies the two things your manager actually cares about from the six things you discussed.
A tool that generates an end-of-meeting summary for 1:1s so neither party leaves with a different memory of what was said.
An AI that translates 'I'm not concerned' from your manager into whether you should be concerned.
A bot that detects when you've been talking to your manager every week for a year and still don't know what they want from you.
An app that detects when a 1:1 is being used to manage a situation your manager should be resolving with their manager.
A tool that tracks how often your 1:1 starts on time, runs the full duration, and ends with something useful.
An AI that identifies which colleagues have monthly 1:1s with your manager and who gets more time, and infers why.
A bot that detects when you've asked for feedback 3 times in a row and received advice about 'personal brand' each time.
An app that helps you raise a difficult topic with your manager in a way that starts a conversation rather than ending one.
A tool that detects when a manager is asking you to solve their management problems inside your 1:1 and reframes the conversation.
An AI that generates a one-year 1:1 retrospective showing what was discussed and what measurably changed.
A bot that detects when you ended a 1:1 without saying the thing you went in to say and schedules a retry.
An app that translates your manager's indirect communication style into what they're actually asking you to do.
A tool that flags when a 1:1 is the only place decisions about your work are being made, without documentation.
An AI that detects when your manager is giving you advice about someone else's problem using your situation as a vehicle.
A bot that detects when you've said 'I'll figure it out' 6 times this month in 1:1s as a way of not asking for help.
An app that identifies when a new manager's 1:1 style is misaligned with yours and suggests how to address it early.
A tool that converts 'let's revisit this next time' into a calendar block so it's actually revisited next time.
An AI that generates a skip-level 1:1 agenda that makes you look strategic without revealing you're stressed.
A bot that detects when a manager is clearly reading from a coaching template rather than responding to you specifically.
An app that tracks whether your manager knows your career goals and follows up when evidence suggests they've forgotten.
A tool that monitors 1:1 sentiment trends and sends an early alert when the trajectory is pointing toward disengagement.
An AI that detects when you've been doing all the agenda prep for months and asks your manager to try.
A bot that detects when a check-in message from your manager arrives 30 minutes before a deadline and interprets it accurately.
An app that detects when your 1:1 is being used as evidence gathering rather than honest conversation.
A tool that generates a 'how I like to be managed' document for people who have never been asked and have things to say.
An AI that identifies the moment in a 1:1 when both parties stopped being honest and marks it as the place to return to.
A bot that sends a summary of your 1:1 to your manager so they can't claim they forgot what was discussed.
An app that detects when your manager's feedback lands differently than intended and asks for a clarifying round.
A tool that identifies which 1:1 topics are consistently raised and never resolved and escalates them automatically.
An AI that generates the 'I need more from this relationship' conversation in a format that's direct without being an ultimatum.
A bot that detects when your 1:1 is the warmest interaction you have with anyone professional all week and flags it for you.
An app that detects when your manager ends the 1:1 with 'any other questions?' 45 seconds before the hour.
